description: A well-formed 64-hex checksum that does not match the evidence it accompanies. THIS FIXTURE IS THE REGRESSION GATE FOR THE RECOMMENDED NEXT PR.

input.itemTitle: Notice with a mismatched provenance checksum
input.rawEvidence: Notice 2026/73. Operators must retain analysis records for five years.

variants.label: wrong-length
variants.comment: The ONE case the format check catches.

variants.label: null-checksum
variants.comment: Optional today (serverAiSummary.ts:239). After the fix, evidence integrity should not be optional.

variants.label: evidence-substituted
variants.rawEvidence: Notice 2026/73. Operators are exempt from all retention requirements.
variants.comment: The attack the fix must stop: a valid checksum paired with substituted evidence. Detectable ONLY by recomputing over the SERVER-LOADED record — which is why F2 cannot be fixed without F1.

notes: Synthetic. At b81fa1f the checksum is format-checked (serverAiSummary.ts:41, 246-248) and never recomputed or compared to anything. The server then writes it into reviewerNotes as 'Checksum: <value>' (:294) so buildAiSummaryRequest can parse it back out with a regex (complianceAiSummarisation.ts:47) — an unverified value round-tripping through a field named for provenance, creating the impression of integrity while providing none. The last variant is the whole argument for the recommended next PR: recomputation is meaningless unless the server loads the authoritative record first.
